_what: Lists as what they are now: tables in the person's own databases (table-lists.ts). A database is any connection the person's vault names ending `credential_suffix` (read by `names_method` at the account's door, names only); each base table outside `skip_schemas` is one list, its columns its fields, its primary key its rows' ids. Every read and change is SQL run by `tool`. A column's kind is the first `kinds` entry whose `types` holds its database type (else `text`); a new field's column type is its kind's `column`. A new list is a new table in the database named `new_lists_in`. Saved views are rows of `views_table` in that same database, made on first save. Page sizes come from lists.json limits.

words.no_key: This table has no key, so its rows cannot be changed here. Your AI can change it with SQL.
words.rename: A table keeps its own name here; your AI can rename it with SQL.
words.unknown: This list is not one of your tables any more.
